name: LAN Network Config
description: Configure Ethernet network interfaces, DHCP/Manual IP mode, subnet mask, default gateway, and DNS server overrides

commands.set_ip_sudo: ip addr flush dev {iface} && ip addr add {ip}/{cidr} dev {iface} && ip link set {iface} up
commands.dhcp_renew_sudo: dhclient -r {iface} || true && dhclient {iface} || ip link set {iface} down && ip link set {iface} up
